mapping.summary: Governed AI-driven AL development: design, test-first build, approvals and gated production deployment.
claims: Aimed at Microsoft partners delivering BC work
Requirement intake captured inside BC with scope and object ranges
Gap analysis plus functional and technical designs for review
Test scripts written and frozen before code, from a separate model call
Compiles against symbols from the live target environment
Solution and test apps installed to a sandbox with generated test data
Tests run under the permission sets each role holds
Server-side gate requires all gates green and recorded approvals before production
Hash-chained, append-only evidence record of every step
Inference on the customer's own Azure AI Foundry deployment
Shows min, expected and max cost estimate before generation
Artifacts stored in SharePoint, Azure Blob or Azure Files
Free install, licence terms agreed with the vendor
